gloss: the whole surface; all aspects; full-scale

definitions.gloss: the whole surface; the entire area
definitions.explanation: The complete surface or area of something physical.
Used figuratively to mean 'in every way' or 'completely,' often modifying nouns to indicate something total or comprehensive.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全面|ぜんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I applied film to the entire surface of the glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全面|ぜんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいた。
⟦{全面的|ぜんめんてき}→全面的：05673_zenmenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}する→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
{全面|ぜんめん}⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk of it escalating into an all-out war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全面|ぜんめん}⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The company carried out a comprehensive review of its products.

notes:
Literally 'entire surface/face' (⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ 'all' + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ 'surface, aspect'). In sense 1, it refers to a physical surface. In sense 2, it is used as a prefix or with ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ to express comprehensiveness or totality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全面的|ぜんめんてき}→全面的：05673_zenmenteki⟧: full-scale, comprehensive, total
- {全面|ぜんめん}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: complete ban
- {全面|ぜんめん}⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧: all-out war
- {全面|ぜんめん}⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧: complete renovation
- {全面|ぜんめん}⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧: comprehensive review
- {全面|ぜんめん}⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: full cooperation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前面|ぜんめん}: the front surface — same pronunciation but different kanji and meaning
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: surface, exterior — refers to the outer layer rather than totality
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: the whole, entirety — broader; not limited to surfaces or aspects
